as_told.title: Gleason couldn't sleep for weeks, built a UFO-shaped house, had 5,000 UFO books

plain: The comedian Jackie Gleason is said to have been so taken with UFOs that he built a house shaped like one. The comedian and podcaster Joe Rogan tells Michels it is a circular house with windows all around, "like a giant UFO made out of wood." Michels tells it himself too, citing Gleason's ex-wife, Beverly McKittrick: he says that after an experience the tellings do not spell out, Gleason could not sleep for weeks, then built the UFO-shaped house in upstate New York and owned some 5,000 books on UFOs. If true, it shows one of the most famous entertainers of his day treating the subject with deep seriousness.
